origin.description: Prints numbers with tagged missing values shown as NA(letter).

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Significant digits used for the finite numbers.

origin.details: The print is the formatted strings, without quotes.
origin.value: Nothing. The formatted vector is printed.
origin.example:
x <- c(1:5, tagged_na("a"), tagged_na("z"), NA)
print_tagged_na(x)

translation.description: Prints numbers with tagged missing values shown as NA(letter).

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Significant digits used for the finite numbers.

translation.details: The print is the formatted strings, without quotes.
